Anika (PM): Quick heads-up — Q3 roadmap sync. Need to lock priorities for VPC control plane + on-prem packaging variants (online installer, offline/air-gapped bundle, HSM/KMS). Two signed PoCs are contingent on air-gap + HSM. Can we list scenarios and tradeoffs?
Dmitri (Eng): Can we get a 2x2 effort vs impact matrix? Also clarify: control plane in-customer VPC vs managed control plane in customer VPC. Installer vs OCI image delivery will change effort a lot.
Sam (Infra): From infra side — air-gapped = zero outbound. Must provide offline bundle + signed checksums, documented verify steps, and an offline license activation flow. Packaging options:
- online installer (pulls images) = medium effort
- air-gap bundle (tarball of images + weights) = high effort (~8GB for model artifacts)
Also need a deployment manifest we can validate. :thinking:
Maya (SRE): Upgrade/rollback story is critical. For air-gapped customers we need a safe upgrade path and a tested rollback. Also runbook for failover if control plane loses connectivity. Otherwise ops handoffs blow up.
Anika (PM): Proposed priority order for Q3: 1) VPC control plane (self-managed control plane in customer's VPC) — high customer unblock; 2) On-prem online installer (for customers with outbound allowed) — medium effort; 3) Air-gapped offline bundle (regulated customers) — highest effort, high value; 4) HSM/KMS deep integration as paid add-on. Map to OKRs: availability & compliance, new enterprise revenue, reduce deal cycles.
Dmitri (Eng): Rough eng estimates (ballpark): VPC control plane ~3 sprints (infra + auth + routing), online installer ~2 sprints, air-gap offline bundle ~4-6 sprints (packaging + signing + test harness), HSM integration ~2 sprints. Model artifact handling increases complexity (quantized vs FP weights).
Sam (Infra): Tradeoffs: offline bundles increase operational support cost (nonzero). We should limit GA to 1 model variant to reduce packaging permutations. Also need SHA256 checksums and signed manifests:
```
sha256sum rdw-offline-2026q3.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign rdw-signing-key.pem rdw-offline-2026q3.tar.gz > rdw.sig
```
Julian (Sales): FYI — two prospects (FinCo, MedCorp) will likely convert if we can promise air-gap + HSM in a Q3 timeline. They expect a 2-year commitment and are ok with an install fee. This should be surfaced to pricing.
Maya (SRE): Validation matrix suggestion: bootstrapping, nodeReplace, modelWarmup, upgradeSmoke, rollbackTest. Each must be automated in the QA harness for GA.
Anika (PM): Ok — action items: @Dmitri update effort estimates in the roadmap doc; @Sam draft Packaging support matrix (limits for GA); @Julian capture commercial terms and pre-sales checklist; @Maya define rollback validation tests. I'll fold into OKR candidates today.
ops-bot: Roadmap epic created: RD-742 (private-deploy/vpc-onprem-packaging).
Dmitri (Eng): One ask — can we carve out a small spike for air-gap validation infra (CI that simulates no-outbound) before we commit to timeline? Will surface risk in the roadmap doc.
Anika (PM): Yes, spike approved (1 week). Add risk flag: model weight transfer size & cust bandwidth.
Julian (Sales): Also flag contract requirement: ability to escrow installer + SOW for onsite install. Customers want that explicitly.
Sam (Infra): Noted. Also callout: offline image distribution options (ship HDD, secure S3 presigned mirror, or private CDN) — cost varies.
Anika (PM): Great. I'll update the roadmap ticket with prioritized scenarios + proposed milestone dates. Will ping again when draft OKRs are ready. :thumbsup:
